I've been a patient here for many years, and the diagnoses are accurate and the fees are reasonable.

However, it's very popular, so you'll have to queue even from early in the morning. It's worth it, and it's understandable if it's for your family.

Dr. Mohei has a wonderful personality, and he even includes a cute photo on the diagnosis report.

We received excellent care for our cat's bile duct obstruction.

The doctor, nurses, and reception staff were all so kind, and even our cat, who hates hospitals, managed to get an IV drip. I was so happy that they kept talking to our fussy cat throughout the drip.

Since this hospital only offers internal medicine treatment, our cat is currently receiving treatment at a different hospital. However, even when I call to pick up medication, they ask how Gare-chan is doing, showing concern for his health, listening to my concerns directly, and offering support.

We hope to return to this hospital after his surgery. Thank you.

Also, I appreciated that they were honest about treatments they couldn't perform.
I have both of my dogs treated here. The head veterinarian and the nurses are all really kind, and the prices are reasonable. I always leave feeling very satisfied.
I took my hamster in for a checkup, and the vets were incredibly kind and caring; I was so touched.

I visited the clinic for a check-up for my hamster.

Although it's not a hospital specializing in exotic animals, they were very kind and provided a thorough examination, including ultrasound and urine tests.

They see patients without appointments, which is very reassuring in case of sudden symptoms.

I can see why this hospital is so popular!
He's a great doctor who will listen to your concerns carefully, even over the phone.

I've been using this clinic for my rabbit's nail trimming.

The doctor and nurses are all very kind.
The vet was very kind, and when I took my hamster in, they handled it very carefully, which was great.

I was so angry I decided to comment. I read the reviews for the first time, and sure enough, it seems like even the level of consultation varies depending on the distrustful opinions, the director's area of ​​expertise, and the animals he likes.

My beloved cat had been vomiting for several days, so I went to see him. He didn't even palpate or touch him; he just looked at him from above. That's unthinkable for a veterinarian! Based solely on the owner's verbal explanation, "Cats vomit a lot. Maybe he has an upset stomach." He assumed he looked fine, and prescribed only a three-day supply of medication without any instructions on how to administer it. The director wouldn't tell me, so I ended up asking the receptionist on my way out. I was shocked.

He became sick again a few days later, and when I went to another hospital, I was told he had liver problems. They ran tests right away, but then told me Mohei needed to fast for blood tests and that the price would be this much.

I can't believe there are really animal hospitals that are this sloppy. I'm shocked and appalled.

I requested a health check-up and nail trimming for my hamster. The vet spoke to my hamster gently and treated him kindly! The wait was long, and there were many customers, but that's because it's a popular clinic!

It's a very trustworthy vet for my precious family member!

About three years ago, I had my cat examined by a vet who was incredibly incapable of diagnosing things. Even when I asked about various possible illnesses, he just said the symptoms were different and gave me a diagnosis with no known cause. He had to insert two IVs into the back to provide hydration, and although I understand that he wanted to insert them quickly, don't you think it's cruel to insert them twice? I wanted to tell him to at least buy a pump. In the end, we went to a different hospital, where he was immediately tested for pancreatitis, diagnosed with it, and treated. Apparently, pancreatitis doesn't always cause vomiting. Doctor, please study up. I still regret that if I hadn't gone to your house, I could have treated him sooner. The thyroid test was a complete waste of time, lol.

The doctors and nurses were all very kind and polite.

The hospital was also clean. …

I don't understand why they have such a good reputation. They have no sense of responsibility for the lives of animals. My beloved cat got burned. It was after 7 PM, so I searched for a hospital that was open and called this hospital, …

I have three cats and they are all well looked after.
They always give me a thorough checkup.
